map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation params to OpenRouter chat completion format with aspect_ratio and image_size
transform_image_generation_request: transform image generation request to OpenRouter chat completion format with image_config
transform_image_generation_response: transform OpenRouter chat completion response to ImageResponse format extracting base64 images
get_supported_openai_params: get supported OpenAI parameters for OpenRouter image generation such as size quality and n
_set_usage_and_cost: extract usage and cost information from OpenRouter response and populate ImageResponse
